Clifton — York, United Kingdom

🟢 Official crime data · North Yorkshire Police, data.police.uk Methodology →

Higher caution advised day Average night

In detail

North Yorkshire Police recorded 149 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 5.3 per 1,000 residents, the 5th highest rate of York's 21 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (4), bicycle theft (2), vehicle crime (2); the evening/night score by violent crime (17), anti social behaviour (10), public order (1). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Clifton safe?

Wandroz currently rates Clifton in York as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in York during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in York at night. This rating is derived from North Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Clifton safe at night?

At night, Clifton is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in York. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Clifton a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Clifton's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in York) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Note that the Booking.com link on this page searches York, not Clifton specifically: Booking does not list this neighbourhood as a destination of its own, so check each property's address against the map above.
